item.title: Trump gives mixed messages about when the war with Iran will end
item.summary: In a phone call with CBS News Monday, Trump said "the war is very complete." But at a separate event with Republican lawmakers, he said the U.S. still needed to achieve "ultimate victory."

item.title: Australia grants asylum to 5 members of the Iranian women's soccer team
item.summary: Australia has granted asylum to five members of the Iranian women's soccer team who were in the country for a tournament when the Iran war began.

item.title: Why Congress rarely pushes back when presidents deploy military force
item.summary: The Constitution gives Congress the power to declare war, but presidents assert broad authority over use of force and the military. Congress has done little to push back.

item.title: Why the 'mad scramble' to fill hormone therapy prescriptions for menopause
item.summary: With the removal of FDA warning labels, hormone therapy to treat symptoms of menopause has grown in popularity. Now some patients are reporting delays in filling prescriptions for estrogen patches.

item.title: Out of work and with 2 teens, this mom may lose food stamps under Trump's changes
item.summary: Policy experts say new SNAP changes don't address the challenges faced by single parents. They also argue that losing food assistance will only create more barriers for struggling families.

item.title: How the blues brought musical journeyman Raphael Saadiq to the Oscars
item.summary: The singer-songwriter and producer has had one of the more distinguished and multifaceted careers in modern music. He talks about following an unconventional path from Tony! Toni! Toné! to Sinners.

item.title: One year later: Mahmoud Khalil remains in limbo but ready to fight
item.summary: The case of Khalil, who was detained last March, sits at the vanguard of a battle of immigrants' due process and civil rights, and the Trump administration's mass detention and deportation policies.

item.title: Georgia special election to replace MTG tests the power of Trump's endorsement
item.summary: Voting ends Tuesday night in the district that former Rep. Marjorie Taylor Greene left this year after a feud with President Trump. It's unclear if his pick will win her spot.

item.title: Alexander brothers convicted of sex trafficking in Manhattan federal court
item.summary: Three brothers, including two of the nation's most successful luxury real estate brokers, were convicted of sex trafficking Monday after a five-week trial.

item.title: Tennessee GOP Rep says Muslims 'don't belong in American society'
item.summary: Rep. Andy Ogles' social media post is the latest in a series of Islamophobic statements from House Republicans.
